description: Imagine crispy, golden churros, hot from the fryer and dusted with cinnamon sugar. Each delightful bite offers a satisfying crunch, perfectly complemented by a rich, velvety chocolate dipping sauce. This classic Mexican treat is a joyous indulgence, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

instructions.title: Prepare the Churro Dough Base
instructions.text: In a medium saucepan, combine water, butter, 1 tablespoon of sugar, and salt. Bring the mixture to a rolling boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat immediately.

instructions.title: Mix the Dough
instructions.text: Add the all-purpose flour to the hot liquid all at once. Stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until a smooth ball of dough forms and pulls away from the sides of the pan. Continue to stir for another minute to dry out the dough slightly.

instructions.title: Incorporate the Eggs
instructions.text: Transfer the dough to a large mixing bowl or a stand mixer. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition until fully incorporated and the dough is smooth and glossy. The dough will look separated at first but will come together. Transfer the dough to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip.

instructions.title: Heat Oil and Prepare Coating
instructions.text: In a large, deep pot or Dutch oven, heat the vegetable oil to 350F (175C). While the oil heats, in a shallow dish, combine the 1/2 cup granulated sugar and ground cinnamon for the churro coating.

instructions.title: Fry the Churros
instructions.text: Carefully pipe 4-6 inch strips of dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen shears or a knife to cut the dough from the piping bag. Fry for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Do not overcrowd the pot.

instructions.title: Coat and Prepare Chocolate Sauce
instructions.text: Remove fried churros with a slotted spoon and drain briefly on paper towels. Immediately toss the hot churros in the cinnamon sugar mixture until evenly coated. For the chocolate sauce, heat heavy cream in a small saucepan until simmering. Remove from heat, add chopped dark chocolate, and let sit for 1 minute before stirring until smooth and glossy.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Arrange the warm, cinnamon-sugar coated churros on a serving platter. Serve with the rich, warm chocolate dipping sauce on the side. Enjoy this delightful Mexican dessert!

tips: For perfectly crispy churros, ensure your oil maintains a consistent temperature of 350F (175C). Use a thermometer for accuracy.
Do not overmix the dough after adding flour, but do ensure the eggs are fully incorporated for a smooth texture.
Serve churros immediately after frying and coating; they are best enjoyed hot and fresh with the warm chocolate sauce.
